Name: Relationship Bar UI
Author: SlyMerc
Description:
Ever been wondering how much experience you need to level up your friendship with someone? Wonder no more!

Introducing the Relationship Bar UI! This simple mod allows to access to seeing your process through your relationships. Don't want everyone's information cluttering your screen? You can go to the config file and simply set anyone's information you wish not to see as "false".
Activation is currently mapped to the "R" button, which is also available for rebounding.

Install
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI


[/list][b]For StardewValley v1.1 and SMAPI.

[/b][u]Road Map[/u]
V1.0 (Official Release): Playtesting confirms that unlocking characters adds them to the UI if enabled and all characters are correctly available on the UI.
V1.1: Ability to detect if the upper left corner of the screen is being in use by other UI and adjusts its starting point accordingly
V1.2: In addition (or instead of) sitting in the top right corner of the normal game scene, the experience bars will be located within the relationship menu itself, along side your normal information.

Patch Notes for Version 1.0:
- added fix where Dwarf and Krobus wouldn't show up properly
- added detection if another mod "Experience Bars" had been downloaded
- added wrap around if relationship bars were to be placed off screen
- fixed crash that happened due to incorrect handling of heart values

Patch Notes for Version 1.1:
-added detection for mod "Cooking Skill" and " Luck Skill"
-new feature: Timed Bars - UI appears only if the relationship exp has changed
- set on or off (true/false) within the config file
- set how long the UI stays on
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Reporting Bugs[/b]
[i]First, make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI and the mod.[/i]

When reporting bugs, please include information about your operating system, game resolution, other mods, and/or events occurring before/at the time.

Downloads.Description: In this version, timed bars have been added. You can have the UI bars only appear for a while after the value has changed.
